entry_points.text: Trivial interrupt aging reports no update when accounting is off.
External surface is group create and publish with per CPU attach, plus runqueue clock refresh and CPU time reads.

exports.text: Group handling creates zeroed groups with fair, real time, extended and clamp state, publishes linkage globally, attaches per CPU fair state, and frees partial storage with no memory signal on failure.
Queue setup readies empty fair and real time queues, links entities to parents with depth and defaults, arms bandwidth timers with quota, and seeds task averages while groups start empty.
Timing support advances runqueue clocks, obtains monotonic CPU time from stable or coupled sources with tick fallback, and folds elapsed and interrupt spans into load sums.
Default frequency capacity reports full scale for platforms without hooks.

hazards.text: Partial alloc leaks without unwind; backward time corrupts sums; synced timers thunder; torn narrow reads break monotonicity; narrow time needs ordered copy pair.

ABI facts: default bandwidth period 100000 us; fresh quota infinite with zero runtime; PELT quantum about 1 us with 1024 unit period; clamps neutral at zero and full scale; fair offset negative shifted; rt prio starts below max with sentinel.
External helpers for lists, masks, atomics, locks, warnings, time and math are owned elsewhere and folded here.

invariants.text: Fair success needs per CPU queues shares and inherited limits; real time success needs per CPU queues entities and period from global control; misses abort and prior storage plus autogroup state is released.
Root is found by address with no entity; others bind to base queue at depth zero or parental queue deeper with assured weight and owner links.

Clamps start neutral and inherit effective parent values with scaled capped buckets; new bandwidth is empty with infinite quota and default period; tasks seed averages from scaled weight, groups stay zero.

Runqueue time is monotonic with drops on retreat and bypass on skip; coupled clocks keep the larger with local clamped to prior plus offset and tick ahead; sums ignore retreat, quantize time and decay per period.
Decay shifts whole periods with table remainder and empties huge gaps; divisor adds partial progress to a minimum; averages divide sums with weighted load; scaling keeps proportion by shift.
Busy queues advance PELT time scaled by processor and frequency; idle queues sync to task time with safe snapshots; reads subtract lost idle and need held lock with fresh clocks.
Attach aligns time and rebuilds sums under queue divisor with floor, folds values upward; detach subtracts and marks negative propagation; lookup follows parent and group links per build.

Queue refresh drains stashed removals, ages with weight and presence, snapshots time; shares skip root and offline, publish gated deltas; propagation clears once and refreshes parents with clip and floor.
Throttle sync copies parent count and marks throttled unless inert; freq notice applies only to roots under protection; extended clock and feature checks empty when off.

locks.text: Publication guards list and parent linkage; fair attach holds each runqueue lock while refreshing clocks and binding entities.
Time readers need held lock and fresh clocks with single skip warning; lock address picks core or private per build; interrupt totals use sequence retry with branch gated enable.

state_machines.text: Clock choice uses stable direct time, tick fallback early, remote coupling for others and clamped local for current.
Groups move alloc to publish to attach with unwind on miss; load flows quantize to decay to accumulate with boundary signal; throttle inherits then clears on enqueue.

structs.text: Per CPU fair runtime, scheduler clock cells and runqueue timing hold clocks, snapshots, offsets and load sums for PELT and task accounting.
Groups join fair and real time queues with bandwidth, extended params, clamps and hierarchy links; queues carry timelines, priorities, timers and propagation state.
